title.zh: 在萨马省San Isidro市镇设立农业工业中学，名称为San Isidro农业工业中学，并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Establishment of an Agro-Industrial High School in the Municipality of San Isidro, Province of Samar, to be Known as San Isidro Agro-Industrial High School, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Establishment of an Agro-Industrial High School in the Municipality of San Isidro, Province of Samar, to be Known as San Isidro Agro-Industrial High School, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

text.en: There shall be established, under the supervision of the Director of Vocational Education, an agro-industrial high school in the Municipality of San Isidro, Province of Samar, to be known as San Isidro Agro-Industrial High School. The site of said school shall be determined by the Municipal Council of San Isidro, in consultation with the Director of Vocational Education.
The Director of Vocational Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.

The sum of one hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said school during the fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty-seven. Thereafter, the necessary funds needed for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1967.
